Step 0x06023320 (0x1e901d0) owns it; the start 0x1dc2980 registers the handler 0x1dc17cc on row 0x47 ({129, 0xd0, 3, 1}: line 129, mode 3 like the countdown-timer rows, taken as an edge; inferred, not measured).
